title: Add release evidence manifest and SBOM
notes: MBR-807 extends, and never forks, the PRE-EXISTING evidence layer: release/evidence/release-evidence.v1.schema.json + scripts/release/verify-release-evidence.mjs (commit 98233f35, landed before MBR-903). That commit already defined and enforced the hash-bound orthic.membrane.release-evidence.v1 manifest shape and its verifier; this task adds the layer that GENERATES real content for it and binds it to MBR-903's evidence/releases/<releaseId>/release-generation.json, instead of duplicating either.

What this task added, all new, under scripts/release/evidence/ (a new subdirectory, per this task's allowed paths) plus release/evidence/sbom.v1.schema.json and docs/release/evidence.md: sbom.mjs (a real SBOM generator -- parsePnpmLock/parseCargoLock are minimal, targeted parsers for apps/membrane-hub/pnpm-lock.yaml and apps/membrane-hub/src-tauri/Cargo.lock; no YAML/TOML package is installed in this workspace and none was named by this task's dispatch, so a general-purpose parser library was not an available Minimize rung -- REUSE/STDLIB/INSTALLED_DEP were checked and rejected before writing these); manifest.mjs (readReleaseGeneration reads MBR-903's release-generation.json as the sole source of release identity; buildProvenance/buildToolchain are new, real, read-only evidence -- git show -s --format=... over the release's own commit, and package.json/Cargo.toml declared toolchain constraints, never an invoked compiler; buildReleaseGenerationEvidence composes those plus the SBOM into a per-releaseId+target report and names every requirement this task cannot produce -- artifact for a not-yet-verified target, tests, signatures, platform_trust, install_receipts, event_history -- as an explicit gap; assembleReleaseEvidenceManifest is the pure object-composition step for once all of that is real, whose output the caller passes to the pre-existing, unmodified verifyReleaseEvidence).

Binding to MBR-903 is demonstrated, not asserted: scripts/release/evidence/manifest.test.mjs's 'buildReleaseGenerationEvidence binds to MBR-903's real release_generation...' test computes release_generation via scripts/release/pipeline/identity.mjs's own computeReleaseGeneration (imported, not reimplemented) over this repository's real, current HEAD commit/tree, writes it into a release-generation.json exactly as multi-platform-release.mjs would, and asserts buildReleaseGenerationEvidence's output.release.generation equals that exact digest byte-for-byte. The 'a manifest assembled with a real MBR-903-style release_generation passes the pre-existing verifier unmodified' test goes further: it builds a complete orthic.membrane.release-evidence.v1 manifest (via assembleReleaseEvidenceManifest, using the same fixture pattern verify-release-evidence.test.mjs already uses for signatures/install_receipts/event_history) keyed to that same real computeReleaseGeneration digest, and confirms scripts/release/verify-release-evidence.mjs's own verifyReleaseEvidence (imported, zero lines changed) accepts it (verified: true).

The SBOM is real, not fabricated, and proven against this repository's actual lockfiles: scripts/release/evidence/sbom.test.mjs's first test runs generateSbom against this checkout's real apps/membrane-hub/pnpm-lock.yaml and apps/membrane-hub/src-tauri/Cargo.lock and asserts 499 real resolved components (28 npm + 471 cargo) with zero gaps, that membrane-updater (the engine's only path dependency compiled into the hub binary) is correctly surfaced as source:'local-path'/checksum:null rather than given a fabricated registry checksum, and that generateSbom is deterministic and hash-binds the exact lockfile bytes it read (generatedFrom). Unit tests separately prove parsePnpmLock/parseCargoLock report an unresolvable entry (no resolution/integrity, or a registry source with no checksum) as a named gap instead of dropping or guessing at it, and that a missing lockfile fails closed rather than silently producing a partial SBOM.

Why apps/membrane-hub/pnpm-lock.yaml + apps/membrane-hub/src-tauri/Cargo.lock and not the root pnpm-lock.yaml or engine/Cargo.lock: those two are the exact JS/TS and Rust dependency graphs `tauri build` compiles into the shipped membrane-hub release artifact. Confirmed by direct inspection: membrane-updater's own block in apps/membrane-hub/src-tauri/Cargo.lock depends only on 'serde', already resolved in that same lockfile -- none of engine/Cargo.lock's separate, larger 13-local-crate graph is transitively compiled into membrane-hub. Root pnpm-lock.yaml and engine/Cargo.lock describe the separate MCP server/engine artifact other Wave 3/4 tasks (e.g. MBR-906) track, not this release target. This scope decision is documented in docs/release/evidence.md and in sbom.mjs's own file-level comment.

This task's manifest builder never produces a schema-valid, verifier-passing release-evidence.v1 manifest for a REAL release today, and does not claim to: no target in this repository's real evidence/releases/ has a sealed, commit-matching, verified artifact for the current HEAD (this task's hard rules forbid running the macOS/Windows right-release build+sign that would produce one), and this task performed no test run, no signing, and no MBR-806 installed-acceptance run. buildReleaseGenerationEvidence() reports this honestly via `status: 'incomplete'` and a `gaps` array (artifact, tests, signatures, platform_trust, install_receipts, event_history) rather than fabricating any of those. Filling them in is deferred to the Book 3 final phased gate, exactly as MBR-901/MBR-902/MBR-903's own acceptance.json gap notes already state for the pieces this task depends on.

No cargo, pnpm, Tauri, right-release, codesign, notarytool, stapler, spctl, signtool, or AzureSignTool command was run at any point. No mutating git command (add/commit/checkout/stash/reset/rebase/push/init) was run anywhere, including inside test fixtures -- manifest.test.mjs deliberately reads this repository's real, existing HEAD commit read-only (git rev-parse / git show -s) rather than fabricating a throwaway git repo, and writes all generated evidence under an isolated os.tmpdir() evidenceRoot, never this repository's tracked evidence/releases/ directory (outside this task's allowed paths). Only `node --test scripts/release/evidence/sbom.test.mjs` and `node --test scripts/release/evidence/manifest.test.mjs` were executed -- see commands.log. `node scripts/qualification/run.mjs --task MBR-807` (the manifest's `commands` entry) was NOT run, per MEMBRANE-BOOK-MODE-EXECUTION-RULES.md: that list runs once at the final phased book gate, not per task.

scripts/release/verify-release-evidence.mjs, release/evidence/release-evidence.v1.schema.json, docs/release/evidence-manifest.md, evidence/releases/README.md, scripts/release/pipeline/identity.mjs -- NOT MODIFIED, imported/read only. scripts/release/pipeline/{multi-platform-release,sealed-platforms,platform-targets}.mjs, scripts/release/{macos,windows,acceptance,channels,homebrew,updater}/**, release/contracts/**, npm/**, package.json, packaging/** -- read for context only, not touched, per this task's allowed-paths restriction.
